plugins.name: agent-team
plugins.description: Lead parallel sub-sessions in the Claude Code desktop app — agent-team:lead turns the current session into a lead that splits work across sub-sessions, verifies their results, runs one-shot code-review sessions, triages fixes, and merges every branch into one PR once the user approves.

plugins.name: skill-simplifier
plugins.description: Audit a SKILL.md (with optional references/) or CLAUDE.md and remove upstream duplication and safeguards against imagined errors a fresh-session model would not make.
